Software Development Engineer II
Job ID: 10533780 | Bengaluru, Karnataka, India

Description:
As a Software Development Engineer II, you will design, build and operate highly available, scalable distributed systems. You will own features end to end: from design and architecture through coding, testing, deployment and operations. You will work with product managers and other engineers to deliver customer-facing capabilities, mentor junior engineers, and raise the bar on engineering best practices through design and code reviews.

Basic qualifications:
- 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- Experience programming with at least one software programming language

Preferred qualifications:
- 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent
- Experience building services in Java on AWS
